newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks pare losses, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks pare losses, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: U.S. stocks cut their losses in half, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to lift curbs on program trading at 1406 EDT/1806 GMT.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was off 15 to 7675 points with about two hours left in the session. The curbs were put into effect earlier when the average fell as much as 60 points to 7630.
The long bond was off 10/32 to yield 6.76 percent.
The Nasdaq Composite was off four to 1442.
